name: genpark-agentic-negotiation-counter-offer-strategist-skill
description: Autonomous Agentic Multi-Turn Negotiator & Counter-Offer Strategist (inspired by Consumer Commerce & Contract Negotiations). Calculates Zone of Possible Agreement (ZOPA), concession decay curves, reservation price thresholds, and structured bargaining counter-offers.

tools.name: negotiate_counter_offer
tools.description: Autonomous multi-turn negotiation: analyze seller bids, calculate ZOPA bargaining range, apply concession curves, and formulate optimal counter-offers.

buyer_reservation_price.description: Maximum buyer is willing to pay (walk-away price).

max_turns.description: Maximum allowed negotiation rounds before walk-away.
